verdict.rationale: Fivetran gives users some control over where data lives. The pricing page lets you pick a cloud provider (GCP, AWS or Azure). It offers both SaaS and Hybrid Deployment models, with Hybrid Deployment Agents running in your own environment. Data lands in a destination warehouse or lake that you choose. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions selecting a geographic region or data-residency guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection documentation, data-residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration.
